description: Fetch the workspace's append-only BYO storage audit log (every AssumeRole, HeadObject, GetObject, KMS Decrypt). Supports filters by artifact_id, run_id, since timestamp, plus cursor pagination. Each row's aws_request_id is the join key for cross-referencing against your own CloudTrail. Requires admin role.

artifact_id.description: Filter to events referencing this artifact.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous call. Pass it back verbatim to fetch the next page; omit on the first call.

run_id.description: Filter to events from this run.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only include events newer than this.

name: edgegate_get_byo_audit
